title: experiment/1
description: The experiment file: the only user-facing configuration format (DESIGN.md 6). Four user-facing fields; these are the experimental variables.
$comment: DESIGN.md 6. The $id host is a placeholder (DESIGN.md 'Open questions'). There are NO grid or matrix fields: a grid is a batch loop over single-design runs (DESIGN.md 10), and additionalProperties:false makes any such field a load-time error. 'control' is a single nullable plugin id, never a list: one selected control per run (DESIGN.md 3 'One selected control per run'), so two controls are inexpressible on-matrix; two-control deployments are expressed only through the fixture composition block, which requires control:null (gated in framework/experiment.py semantic validation).

control.$comment: DESIGN.md 6: required, nullable. null means no selected control, intrinsic enforcement active. One plugin id; selection counts plugins, never positions (DESIGN.md 3).

designs.$comment: DESIGN.md 6: required, explicit, validated. The runner never infers designs; one run per design.

items.$comment: DESIGN.md 7: designs T0-T7 are core, versioned with the major release. t7 is the kernel-level observation row.

harness.$comment: DESIGN.md 6: user-specified; default is the prepared default harness (recorded as a fact, not requested as a choice).

workload.$comment: DESIGN.md 6: user-specified; default is the prepared default pack (baseline-15).

fixture.$comment: DESIGN.md 6: optional override of the reference rig. A composition block declares two controls and requires control:null (DESIGN.md 6 'Composition'); it auto-sets off_matrix:true, which is why off_matrix is not a writable field here (DESIGN.md 6: 'the flag need not be written explicitly').

composition.$comment: DESIGN.md 6 'Composition': two controls, off-matrix by construction (DESIGN.md 7: two selected controls run only as off-matrix composition fixtures).
